answer: Audits are published in kernel, queued in gale, and bridge publishes the wait time. A farm of 83 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. A farm of 2279 identities would post 3133 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
